Henderson’s mixed model equations single random genetic effect, y=Xb+Zu+e,u∼N(0,Kσu2),e∼N(0,Iσe2),y = Xb + Zu + e, \qquad u \sim N(0, K\sigma^2_u), \qquad   e \sim N(0, \sigma^2_e), solved directly λ=σe2/σu2\lambda = \sigma^2_e / \sigma^2_u: [X′XX′ZZ′XZ′Z+K−1λ][bu]=[X′yZ′y].\begin{bmatrix} X'X & X'Z \\ Z'X & Z'Z + K^{-1}\lambda \end{bmatrix}   \begin{bmatrix} b \\ u \end{bmatrix} =   \begin{bmatrix} X'y \\ Z'y \end{bmatrix}. Put H KK solution covers every individual pedigree, genotyped . validation one breeder actually cares : hide records youngest generation, predict breeding values parents markers, see well predictions correlate truth simulation knows. stature simulated heritability 0.6, value used . real analysis variance components estimated, REML package sommer, rrBLUP, BGLR lme4qtl, standalone software ASReml BLUPF90; accept relationship matrix inverse, package produces. code: ph  <- SummarizedExperiment::colData(be) ids <- rownames(H)  train  <- ph$generation != 5                 # records we are allowed to use target <- colnames(be)[ph$generation == 5]   # the ones we must predict y <- ph$stature[train]  X <- matrix(1, length(y), 1)                 # an intercept only Z <- matrix(0, length(y), length(ids))       # records to individuals Z[cbind(seq_along(y), match(colnames(be)[train], ids))] <- 1 c(records = length(y), predicted = length(target)) #>   records predicted  #>        75        45 blup <- function(K, h2) {   lambda <- (1 - h2) / h2   lhs <- rbind(cbind(crossprod(X),    crossprod(X, Z)),                cbind(crossprod(Z, X), crossprod(Z) + solve(K) * lambda))   rhs <- rbind(crossprod(X, y), crossprod(Z, y))   stats::setNames(solve(lhs, rhs)[-1, 1], ids) }  ebv_pedigree   <- blup(A[ids, ids], h2 = 0.6) ebv_singlestep <- blup(H,           h2 = 0.6) true <- stats::setNames(ph$trueBV_stature, colnames(be)) round(c(pedigree   = cor(ebv_pedigree[target],   true[target]),         singlestep = cor(ebv_singlestep[target], true[target])), 3) #>   pedigree singlestep  #>      0.410      0.435 op <- par(mfrow = c(1, 2), mar = c(4, 4, 3, 1)) for (nm in c("pedigree", "singlestep")) {   e <- if (nm == "pedigree") ebv_pedigree else ebv_singlestep   plot(true[target], e[target], pch = 16, col = "steelblue",        xlab = "true breeding value", ylab = "predicted",        main = sprintf("%s (r = %.3f)", nm, cor(e[target], true[target])))   abline(lm(e[target] ~ true[target]), col = "firebrick", lwd = 2) } par(op) ungenotyped <- setdiff(ids, attr(H, "genotyped")) length(ungenotyped) #> [1] 60 summary(ebv_singlestep[ungenotyped]) #>    Min. 1st Qu.  Median    Mean 3rd Qu.    Max.  #> -7.4187 -1.9093 -0.3128 -0.6866  0.3059  5.4087
